title: Beyond Discrimination: Calibrated Geoprior Fusion for Bioacoustic Monitoring
abstract: arXiv:2609.35863v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Modern bioacoustic foundation models like Perch and BirdNET can identify species with high discriminative accuracy, yet their confidence scores are often uncalibrated and difficult to interpret as probabilities of real-world occurrence. This limits their use for ecological inference beyond threshold-based detection. We leverage a global annotated acoustic dataset (WABAD) to produce calibration priors for an acoustic model, optionally incorporating species-level information. We introduce new methods of fusing the acoustic predictions with geopriors, which empirically improves calibration while preserving discrimination. Together, these results suggest a path to simpler and more reliable acoustic monitoring for broad biodiversity.

translated_title: 超越判别：面向生物声学监测的校准地理先验融合方法
translated_abstract: 像Perch和BirdNET这样的现代生物声学基础模型能够以很高的判别准确率识别物种，但它们的置信度分数往往未经校准，难以被解释为物种在现实世界中出现的概率。这限制了它们在基于阈值的检测之外的生态推断中的应用。我们利用一个全球标注声学数据集（WABAD）为声学模型生成校准先验，并可选择性地纳入物种层面的信息。我们提出了将声学预测与地理先验相融合的新方法，该方法在实证上提升了模型的校准性能，同时保留了原有的判别能力。这些结果共同表明了一条实现更简单、更可靠的大范围生物多样性声学监测的路径。
tldr: 该论文提出将声学模型预测与地理先验融合的新方法，利用全球标注数据集WABAD生成校准先验，在保持物种识别判别精度的同时显著改善置信度校准，为更可靠的生态推断和生物多样性声学监测提供了可行路径。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes novel methods for fusing acoustic model predictions with geopriors, leveraging the global annotated WABAD dataset to generate calibration priors that improve calibration while preserving discrimination, paving the way for more reliable ecological inference and bioacoustic biodiversity monitoring.
